overview: A global crypto-to-fiat marketplace where buyers pay with cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC) and sellers receive fiat payouts via Stripe Connect. Features user accounts, product listings with image uploads, real-time crypto exchange rates, and full transaction history.
features: User accounts with Internet Identity login and seller/buyer roles
Marketplace listings with title, description, price, category, and cover image
Crypto payment checkout via NOWPayments (BTC, ETH, USDC)
Real-time crypto/USD exchange rates at checkout
Transaction history for buyers and sellers
Seller dashboard with Stripe Connect payout management
Search and category filter for browsing listings
